info.name: AURA Marketplace API
info.description:
End-to-end API tests for the AURA Marketplace backend.

Run with Newman:

    newman run AURA-Marketplace.postman_collection.json -e local.postman_environment.json

Requests run in order: the auth folder seeds `authToken`, and later folders reuse it. `registerEmail` is randomised per run so the suite is repeatable.
